title: A change to a kbcommon.SECRETS shape reads the verdicts the old shape cached: the publish scan's cache key holds SCAN_FORM, which no one bumps
goal: kbpublic.scan_form, the leak scan's cache key, holds a digest of kbcommon.SECRETS beside SCAN_FORM and the registry's private patterns, so a change to a secret shape (BG-3vnu37rq narrowed the armor line to one with key material after it) reads no verdict cached under the old shape, and the repro exits 0

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0, "_tools"); import hashlib, kbcommon, kbpublic; sys.exit(0 if hashlib.sha256(kbcommon.secrets_rx().encode()).hexdigest()[:12] in kbpublic.scan_form() else 1)
